items.name: St. John the Evangelist Church (St. Michael the Archangel Parish)
items.summary: Winthrop's active Catholic parish church, seat of St. Michael the Archangel Parish (formed Feb 2021 from St. John the Evangelist and Holy Rosary); its lower level is now called Holy Rosary Chapel.
items.serviceTimes: Saturday vigil 4pm; Sunday 8am, 10am, 12 noon, 5pm (St. John the Evangelist Church) and 11am (Holy Rosary Chapel); daily Mass Mon-Sat 9am (Holy Rosary Chapel)

items.name: First Church of Winthrop, United Methodist
items.summary: Active United Methodist congregation on Metcalf Square whose building also hosts a community thrift shop listed in the town newsletter.
items.serviceTimes: Sunday 11:00am in the Sanctuary (September-June); Sunday 10:00am in the Chapel (July-August)

items.name: St. John's Episcopal Church
items.summary: Active Episcopal parish at the corner of Bowdoin and Buchanan Streets, home of the Winthrop Community Food Pantry.

items.name: Temple Tifereth Israel
items.summary: Winthrop's synagogue, in its Veterans Road building since the 1960s after starting on Shirley Street in 1916, still holding Shabbat services and a Hebrew school.

items.name: Restoration Church - Winthrop (formerly Harbor City Church)
items.denomination: Evangelical / Baptist (Baptist Churches of New England network)
items.summary: Church-planted congregation in Winthrop Center that joined the multi-site Restoration Church family in 2026 and meets in the second-floor worship center at 49 Adams Street.
